resources.string: Dev only — starts phone HFP SCO (not BiCROS). Confuses most users; leave off.
Off by default — SPP log traffic can fight BiCROS. Turn on only when capturing a bug report.
Apply saves to both buds (survives case). Get / Connect reloads from the bud. Phone rocker while BiCROS is on = CROS path level (not music).
Default: Right = poor, Left = good (master). Poor ear must not be the TWS master or enable is refused.
DIY / own-risk — not a hearing aid

PineBuds Pro BiCROS is experimental firmware on consumer earbuds. It is not a medical device, prescribed CROS/BiCROS, or certified hearing protection.

Flash and use only if you can restore stock firmware. Loud levels and feedback (howling) are possible if you bypass the mix ceiling (−12 dB).

Poor ear must stay the TWS slave (default: Right poor / Left master).
You set poor = Left. On most setups Left is the TWS master — BiCROS enable will be refused (known crash if forced).\n\nKeep Right = poor unless you have made Right the master. Apply anyway?
